diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.memoryIndexArrayIncrementAssignment: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.assignIncDec v✝ op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) ie✝) hs✝)
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.update
    ((Upd.nil.snoc
          (UpdElem.memory
            (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower)
              (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower)))))).snoc
      (UpdElem.local v✝
        (Rhs.val
          (Tms.Term.bumped op✝ hp✝ (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower))))))

C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
v✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.val p✝)

hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ : RefTy
mk✝ : ArrTy x✝ (Ty.prim p✝)
mv✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.mem x✝)
hmv✝ : (Ty.ref x✝).mapFree = true
ie✝ : Simple C✝ Γ✝ PrimTy.uint
hs✝ : (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) ie✝).recvSimple = true
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.assignIncDec v✝ op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) ie✝) hs✝) =
    Premise.update
      ((Upd.nil.snoc
            (UpdElem.memory
              (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower)
                (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower)))))).snoc
        (UpdElem.local v✝
          (Rhs.val
            (Tms.Term.bumped op✝ hp✝ (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower))))))
